mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an emergency monetary policy response that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI change exceeds 3.0%, it triggers central bank tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, residential construction permits above 1000 thousand units signal housing market strength that stimulates economic activity and lifts equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In post-pandemic recovery periods, 60-day SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of HOUST > 1000 instances, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO above 12-month MA periods, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits decline below 900 thousand units, it signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of HOUST < 900 instances, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes, 60-day SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of UNRATE decline > 0.2pp instances, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates active monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL rise and FEDFUNDS stability fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.
